market_identity.question: Will the US capture another world leader in 2026?

frozen_rule_scope: “Another” active head of state of a UN member state at capture; physical detention/custody such that not free to leave; direct on-the-ground participation by U.S. government personnel required (support/intelligence/logistics/advisory alone insufficient); interim heads count if widely recognized; contractors only when confirmed under U.S. direction. Resolution source is consensus credible reporting.

maduro_prior_event_source.summary: The prior captured White House statement reports Maduro was apprehended and quotes Secretary Rubio saying U.S. forces were on the ground for about two hours during the capture; Rubio also said Maduro was not head of state. This is the administration’s account, not independent adjudication of the frozen status criterion.

Search snippet attributes to an ALBA communiqué the description of Maduro as constitutional president/head of state on Jan 3. This is an attributed Venezuelan/ALBA position transmitted in a UN document, not a UN finding. A separate targeted UN Press search did not surface a relevant 2026 status determination.
